d: Diwali 2026 Jharkhand : jharkhand men divali ki raunak dekhte hi ban rahi hai. ranchi ke patakha bajar men kharidaron ki bhir umar rahi hai. bachche hon ya bare, har koee dipavli ki taiyariyon men juta hai. vahin lohradga men kumharon ke samne is bar mushkilen barh gaee hain. mahangaee aur barish ne mitti ke khilaunon aur diyon ko nuksan pahunchaya hai. pushtaini paranpra ko bachane ki koshish kar rahe kumharon ki mehnat par mausam aur mahangaee ki dohri mar par rahi hai. aakhir is divali bajar men kitni raunak hai aur kumharon ki kya hai kahani? dekhie puri riporta.
